name: flutter_handbreak
desc:
flutter_handbreak — lightweight, quality-first video & image compression
Inspired by HandBrake's pipeline. No GPL code copied; concepts re-implemented MIT.

name: AdvancedEncoderOptions
desc:
Advanced encoder knobs — codec-specific tuning without polluting the basic API.
Example: AdvancedEncoderOptions(crf: 22, preset: 'slow', tune: 'film', extra: {'profile':'high'})

name: crf
desc: Explicit native CRF/QP numeric. If set, overrides RateControl quality mapping.

name: AudioCodec
desc: Audio codec/mode. We never destroy audio silently.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: AverageBitrateRateControl
desc: Average-bitrate mode. Two-pass only where it provides real value — disabled by default on mobile.

name: CompressionJob
desc:
Live handle returned by VideoCompressor.start / ImageCompressor.start.
Mirrors HandBrake's job lifecycle (HB_STATE_WORKING → HB_STATE_DONE) with Dart streams.

name: cancel
desc: Idempotent cancellation: stops native encoder, releases codecs, deletes partial file.

name: progress
desc: Broadcast progress — based on real PTS/frame counts (never synthetic).

name: result
desc: Completes with CompressionResult on success, or throws typed HandbreakException.

name: CompressionProgress
desc:
Progress based on actual media timestamps/frames — mirrors sync.c's frame_count/est_frame_count model.
Never faked with timers.

name: processedDurationMs
desc: Already processed media time, not wall-clock.

name: progress
desc: 0.0..1.0 — clamped like sync.c does.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: CompressionResult
desc: Returned after mux+validate. Re-probed output is embedded as outputMediaInfo.

name: compressionPercentage
desc: 0..100 percentage saved.

name: compressionRatio
desc: original / output (e.g. 3.2 = ~69% saved).

name: estimatedOutputSizeBytes
desc: Returned by native when estimation is possible under CQ.

name: qualityWarning
desc: Set when recompressing already-heavily-compressed material likely degrades quality.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: wasKeptOriginal
desc: True when keepOriginalIfSmaller kept the original because output would be larger.

name: ConstantQualityRateControl
desc: Constant-quality via discrete level → codec-aware CRF resolution.

name: ConstantQualityValueRateControl
desc:
Constant-quality via explicit native CRF/QP numeric.
Advanced; codec-specific valid ranges apply — see QualityMapper.validRangeFor.

name: ContainerSupport
desc:
Muxer reality per platform — what containers can actually be written.
Android MediaMuxer: MPEG_4, WEBM (VP8/VP9 + Opus/Vorbis), 3GP(h263), OGG(Opus API29+).
iOS AVAssetExportSession: mp4/mov/m4v only.

name: codecFits
desc: Codec-level compatibility beyond container presence.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: resolve
desc: Resolve everything needed for a deterministic native execution.

name: FlutterHandbreak
desc: Lightweight, HandBrake-inspired facade — easy to use, quality-first.

name: compressImage
desc: Compress any image (jpeg/png/webp/heic/avif) — auto format, never grows file by default.

name: compressVideo
desc:
Compress any video format (mp4/mov/mkv/webm/...) — HandBrake-style fallback
ensures output is always a playable mp4/mov even when input container is exotic.

name: compressVideoWithOptions
desc: Explicit options escape hatch — HandBrake-grade control.

name: FrameRateMode
desc: Frame-rate handling. Mirrors HandBrake's CFR/VFR choice.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: HandbreakException
desc:
Structured error hierarchy mirroring HandBrake's done_error categories.
Every native error is mapped to one of these; nativeCode/nativeMessage
are preserved for diagnostics without leaking internals.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: HandbreakProbe
desc:
Robust source analysis — must run before encode when safe processing
requires it. Mirrors HandBrake's scan.c → hb_title_t.

name: HardwareAcceleration
desc: Hardware encoder selection policy — mirrors HandBrake's hwaccel fallback logic.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: HardwareCapabilities
desc: Snapshot of device encode/decode capabilities. Queried via native MediaCodecList / VideoToolbox.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: quality
desc: 0..100 — perceptual quality (higher = larger & better). 82 is a balanced default.

name: compress
desc:
One-shot image compression. Returns CompressionResult (or a subclass
carrying image-specific fields from native).

name: start
desc: Start with progress + cancellation support.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: ImagePlanTokens
desc: Small helper so callers without full MediaInfo can still resolve image jobs consistently.

name: JobHandle
desc: Internal convenience used by platform impls that back jobs with EventChannel + MethodChannel.

name: MediaInfo
desc:
Robust source analysis — mirrors HandBrake's scan.c title probe.
Every field that can influence the encode decision is surfaced here.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: QualityMapper
desc:
Codec-aware quality mapping.
HandBrake's lesson: lower number can mean higher quality depending on codec.
Each codec has its own valid CRF/QP range; we map discrete VideoQuality → native value.

name: crfFor
desc:
Map discrete quality → codec-specific CQ numeric.
Defaults are chosen for perceptual quality-first mobile encodes (like HandBrake's sane defaults).

name: targetBitrateFor
desc:
Android MediaCodec bitrate-mode mapping for ABR target.
When using CQ on MediaCodec we drive via KEY_QUALITY/CRF shim where available; else fallback to VBR.

name: validRangeFor
desc:
Valid inclusive range for the numeric CQ value per codec.
These mirror the encoder presets: x264 0..51, x265 0..51, VP9 0..63, AV1 0..63, MediaCodec QP 0..51 etc.

name: RateControl
desc: Preferred rate-control mode. Constant-quality is default (HandBrake-aligned).

name: ResolutionCalculator
desc:
Pure, heavily-tested resolution math — mirrors HandBrake's
picture sizing (sanitize_filter_list_pre/post + hb_geometry_t handling).

name: applyRotation
desc:
Correct width/height for rotation metadata (HandBrake's title->geometry + rotation fix).
Rotation 90/270 swaps dimensions.

name: calculate
desc:
Compute output dimensions from source + constraints.
srcWidth/srcHeight are rotation-corrected (like job->width/height after HandBrake's geometry fix).
Returns even (modulo=2) dimensions, never 0.

name: estimateTotalFrames
desc: Estimate total frames for progress denominator (like job->frame_count from duration×fps).

name: estimatedRemaining
desc: Remaining wall-clock estimate — like HandBrake's estimatedRemaining derived from fps.

name: progress
desc: Progress math matching sync.c: progress = frame_count / est_frame_count, clamped.

name: ResolvedAudioPlan
desc: Effective audio execution plan after fallback resolution.

name: mode
desc: passthrough | transcode | remove

name: note
desc: Human-readable note when a fallback occurred (surfaced via qualityWarning).

name: ResolvedPlan
desc: Fully-resolved, native-executable encode plan.

name: containerId
desc: Effective container id after muxer-support fallback (mp4|mov|webm).

name: limitFrameRate
desc: True when target < source → decoder-output PTS gate drops frames (never duplicates).

name: rateControlMode
desc: cq | cq_value | abr

name: values

desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: VideoCodec
desc: Pluggable video codecs. Default is H.264 for broad mobile compatibility.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: keepOriginalIfSmaller
desc: If compressed output would be larger than source, return original (or keep smaller).

name: overwriteExisting
desc: Overwrite outputPath if it already exists. Default false → throws OutputCreationException.

name: presetName
desc: Tag for analytics/presets — not sent to native encoder.

name: quality
desc: @deprecated Use rateControl. Kept for ergonomics.

name: tempoScale
desc: Playback speed multiplier (future: time-stretch filter). 1.0 = unchanged.

name: compress
desc: Simple one-shot compress — wraps start + await job.result.

name: compressWithPreset
desc: Preset-based convenience.

name: platform
desc:
Returns the registered platform implementation, lazily registering the
method-channel default when the app hasn't injected one. Tests inject a
mock via HandbreakPlatform.instance before calling compressors.

name: start
desc: Start a job and return a live handle with progress stream and cancel.

name: VideoContainer
desc: Container. MP4 is default; MKV used where Opus/AV1 passthrough prefers it.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: VideoFilter
desc:
Composable filter pipeline inspired by HandBrake's hb_filter_object_t chain.
Filters are data objects; native resolves ordering and executes them.

name: toOptions
desc: Resolve preset → concrete options. Caller may override individual fields afterwards via copyWith.

name: VideoPresetAlias
desc: Legacy alias so callers can write VideoPreset.balanced like the spec example.

name: VideoPresetId
desc:
Presets — conceptual analogues of HandBrake's built-ins, but tuned for mobile.
Each preset maps to {codec, container, quality, max resolution, max fps, audio, hw policy}.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: VideoQuality
desc:
Discrete constant-quality levels. Mapped codec-specifically in QualityMapper.
DO NOT treat these as universal numbers; each codec maps them to its own CRF/QP range.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: isPortrait
desc: Portrait after rotation correction?

name: defaultTargetPlatformName
desc: Name used for capability lookups when the platform query itself failed.

name: kAndroidMp4CopyableAudio
desc: Audio codecs that can be bit-copied into MP4-family containers on Android.

name: kCanonicalFilterOrder
desc:
Canonical filter order mirroring HandBrake's sanitize_filter_list_pre/post:
crop → scale → pad → rotate → deinterlace → denoise → sharpen → grayscale

name: kIosCopyableAudio
desc: iOS ExportSession re-encodes regardless; treat copy conservatively.

name: mapNativeError
desc: Map a native error code string to a typed exception.
